ttm.note: Latest report filed on or before 2026-10-21 is the Q2 2026 results 6-K (filed 2026-08-06; GAAP statements incorporated into S-8). Q3 2026 results are scheduled for 2026-11-05. The 2030 notes are shown as a current liability at Jun 30 2026 (carrying $733.588M vs $731.680M at Dec 31 2025, difference equals amortization); treat full $750M as a possible near-term cash/share settlement claim. Fair value at June 30 2026 is not disclosed in the filings reviewed through2026-10-21; it remains null and was not estimated. A $200M share repurchase program was announced in a 6-K filed 2026-09-02 (after the balance-sheet date; no repurchases recorded in H1 2026). Share count is the May 12 2026 proxy figure, 49 days before the period end. The June 30 convertible fair value is null; the former carried December 31 fair value has been removed from this period. Contractual terms remain sourced to the annual filing.

notes: Nova files 20-F annually and furnishes quarterly results as a 6-K press release with condensed GAAP statements. Amounts converted from USD thousands to USD millions.
Capped calls on the 2030 notes are equity-classified and not recorded as assets or claims here.
